resolved_findings.trigger: A cache tree copied from another valid formal run can pass checks against its own provenance.
resolved_findings.effect_before_fix: Analysis could label another run's features with the requested live run context.
resolved_findings.resolution: Explicit expected role/run/current-manifest identity supplied on every load/verify, including dev and all seven completed-analysis reuse checks.
resolved_findings.verified: Final source reread and synthetic test contract assertions.

resolved_findings.trigger: Fewer than twenty target real CAL videos.
resolved_findings.effect_before_fix: Empty target thresholds reached the operating bootstrap and aborted the full analysis.
resolved_findings.resolution: Driver writes UNAVAILABLE_CALIBRATION_BUDGET with intervals null and available CAL count.

resolved_findings.trigger: A mandatory numerical control or control-score cell has unresolved high-precision ordering.
resolved_findings.effect_before_fix: Top-level receipt could omit unresolved controls while subsidiary rows were unavailable.
resolved_findings.resolution: Numerical audit/control-score ranking_usable false flags propagate into limitations and ANALYSIS_COMPLETE_WITH_NUMERIC_NA.

minor_findings.trigger: Serializing thousands of bootstrap draws with many source groups.
minor_findings.effect: Sparse exact multiplicity mappings expand into Python dictionaries and indented JSON; output size and serialization time remain proportional to repeats times groups.
minor_findings.proposal: For large production outputs, keep group-name index plus integer multiplicity arrays in a separate compressed array artifact, and save draw metrics plus its hash in JSON. This is a tractability improvement, not a current correctness blocker.

synthetic_probe.production_scope: Actual production group counts and storage were not benchmarked.

independent_execution_evidence.actual_write_scores_read_scores_in_memor: PASSED using StringIO and no-write directory stub; synthetic scores differing at 1e-200/1e-210 retained ordering.
independent_execution_evidence.synthetic_extreme_logits_numeric_check: Four unusable numerical audit rows observed; final propagation branch includes ranking_usable false audit/control rows.
independent_execution_evidence.scientific_evidence_limit: All execution evidence above uses synthetic fixtures solely for implementation verification. It is not a paper result or a formal-model performance claim.

operational_boundaries.production_gate: Actual analysis remains gated by new frozen formal checkpoints and all seven verified cache roles.
